sentences.text: James Marshall `` Jimi '' Hendrix -LRB- born Johnny Allen Hendrix ; November 27 , 1942 -- September 18 , 1970 -RRB- was an American rock guitarist , singer , and songwriter .

Although his mainstream career spanned only four years , he is widely regarded as one of the most influential electric guitarists in the history of popular music , and one of the most celebrated musicians of the 20th century .
The Rock and Roll Hall of Fame describes him as `` arguably the greatest instrumentalist in the history of rock music '' .	Rock	Rock music	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame
Born in Seattle , Washington , Hendrix began playing guitar at the age of 15 .	Seattle	Seattle

In 1961 , he enlisted in the U.S. Army and trained as a paratrooper in the 101st Airborne Division ; he was granted an honorable discharge the following year .	paratrooper	paratrooper	101st Airborne Division	101st Airborne Division

Soon afterward , he moved to Clarksville , Tennessee , and began playing gigs on the Chitlin ' Circuit , earning a place in the Isley Brothers ' backing band and later with Little Richard , with whom he continued to work through mid-1965 .	the Isley Brothers	the Isley Brothers	Little Richard	Little Richard

He then played with Curtis Knight and the Squires before moving to England in late 1966 after being discovered by Linda Keith , who in turn interested bassist Chas Chandler of the Animals in becoming his first manager .	Curtis Knight	Curtis Knight	Linda Keith	Linda Keith	Chas Chandler	Chas Chandler	the Animals	the Animals

Within months , Hendrix had earned three UK top ten hits with the Jimi Hendrix Experience : `` Hey Joe '' , `` Purple Haze '' , and `` The Wind Cries Mary '' .	the Jimi Hendrix Experience	the Jimi Hendrix Experience	Hey Joe	Hey Joe	Purple Haze	Purple Haze	The Wind Cries Mary	The Wind Cries Mary

He achieved fame in the U.S. after his performance at the Monterey Pop Festival in 1967 , and in 1968 his third and final studio album , Electric Ladyland , reached number one in the U.S. ; it was Hendrix 's most commercially successful release and his first and only number one album .	Monterey Pop Festival	Monterey Pop Festival	Electric Ladyland	Electric Ladyland

The world 's highest-paid performer , he headlined the Woodstock Festival in 1969 and the Isle of Wight Festival in 1970 before his accidental death from barbiturate-related asphyxia on September 18 , 1970 , at the age of 27 .	Woodstock	Woodstock	Isle of Wight Festival	Isle of Wight Festival 1970	his accidental death	Death of Jimi Hendrix	barbiturate	barbiturate	asphyxia	asphyxia
Hendrix was inspired musically by American rock and roll and electric blues .	blues	blues	rock and roll	rock and roll	electric blues	electric blues

He favored overdriven amplifiers with high volume and gain , and was instrumental in utilizing the previously undesirable sounds caused by guitar amplifier feedback .	overdriven	Distortion (music)	gain	Gain (electronics)	guitar amplifier feedback	Guitar feedback

He helped to popularize the use of a wah-wah pedal in mainstream rock , and was the first artist to use stereophonic phasing effects in music recordings .	wah-wah pedal	wah-wah pedal	stereophonic	stereophonic sound	phasing	Phaser (effect)
Holly George-Warren of Rolling Stone commented : `` Hendrix pioneered the use of the instrument as an electronic sound source .	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone

Players before him had experimented with feedback and distortion , but Hendrix turned those effects and others into a controlled , fluid vocabulary every bit as personal as the blues with which he began . ''	blues	blues
Hendrix was the recipient of several music awards during his lifetime and posthumously .
In 1967 , readers of Melody Maker voted him the Pop Musician of the Year , and in 1968 , Rolling Stone declared him the Performer of the Year .	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone	Melody Maker	Melody Maker
Disc and Music Echo honored him with the World Top Musician of 1969 and in 1970 , Guitar Player named him the Rock Guitarist of the Year .	Rock	Rock music	Disc and Music Echo	Disc (magazine)

The Jimi Hendrix Experience was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 1992 and the UK Music Hall of Fame in 2005 .	Rock	Rock music	The Jimi Hendrix Experience	The Jimi Hendrix Experience	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	UK Music Hall of Fame	UK Music Hall of Fame

Rolling Stone ranked the band 's three studio albums , Are You Experienced , Axis : Bold as Love , and Electric Ladyland , among the 100 greatest albums of all time , and they ranked Hendrix as the greatest guitarist and the sixth greatest artist of all time .
